channel.title: Deal Notes
channel.description: Buying guides and deal-event help for Amazon shoppers

item.title: Amazon's 2026 holiday return window runs to Jan. 31, 2027
item.description: Most items bought on Amazon from Nov. 1 through Dec. 31, 2026 can be returned through Jan. 31, 2027, per Amazon's return policy page. Apple-brand products have an earlier Jan. 15 deadline.

item.title: Baby Brezza recalls SuperFast sterilizer dryers over overheating
item.description: About 29,000 Baby Brezza SuperFast sterilizer dryers can overheat while plugged in and running, posing a burn hazard, the CPSC says. Baby Brezza is offering free replacements.

item.title: Bose recalls S1 Pro and S1 Pro+ speaker battery packs over fire risk
item.description: About 634,759 lithium-ion battery packs for Bose S1 Pro and S1 Pro+ portable Bluetooth speakers can overheat and ignite, the CPSC says. Bose is offering free replacement packs.

item.title: Gourmia recalls about 175,951 9-slice digital air fryer ovens
item.description: The doors on Gourmia 9-slice digital air fryer ovens can close unexpectedly when bumped, posing a burn hazard, the CPSC says. Gourmia is mailing free repair kits.

item.title: Little Giant recalls about 3.66 million ladders with Rapid Locks
item.description: The CPSC says Little Giant ladders with Rapid Locks can suddenly retract if the locks are not fully engaged, posing a fall hazard. Owners should stop using them and get a repair kit.

item.title: Amazon's Alexa for Shopping shows 30-, 90- and 365-day price history
item.description: Amazon's updated guide to its Alexa for Shopping assistant says it shows price history over 30, 90 and 365 days and can set price alerts or auto-buy at a target price.

item.title: Amazon confirms Black Friday on Nov. 27 and Cyber Monday on Nov. 30
item.description: Amazon's holiday guide confirms the 2026 Black Friday and Cyber Monday dates and says early deals are already live in its Holiday Shop. It has not yet posted Black Friday Week event dates.

item.title: Apple TV 4K (4th generation) goes on sale Nov. 13 at $299
item.description: Apple's new Apple TV 4K adds an A19 chip, far-field microphones for hands-free Siri and four-speaker HomePod surround support. Pre-orders opened Oct. 13; stores get it Nov. 13.

item.title: Kitchen gear worth buying on Amazon
item.description: Five kitchen basics with long track records in independent testing: a chef's knife, cast-iron skillet, instant-read thermometer and kitchen scale. How we chose and what to check.

item.title: Home office gear worth buying on Amazon
item.description: Webcam, wireless keyboard, mechanical keyboard and mouse picks for a home office, chosen from current test-based reviews. No fake testing, no scraped prices.

item.title: Tech accessories worth buying on Amazon
item.description: USB-C charger, cable, power bank and e-reader picks from current test-based reviews, plus how to avoid unsafe no-name chargers. Check live prices on Amazon.

item.title: Starter tools worth buying on Amazon
item.description: A cordless drill, drill bit set and tape measure chosen from current test-based reviews, plus a ladder recall to check. Live prices on Amazon.

item.title: Outdoor gear worth buying on Amazon
item.description: Headlamp, water bottle, cooler and camp chair picks for camping and day trips, chosen from current test-based reviews. How we chose, what to check, live prices on Amazon.

item.title: Gift ideas by recipient and budget
item.description: Holiday gift ideas sorted by who you are shopping for and rough budget band, drawn from our test-backed buying guides. Includes Amazon's 2026 holiday return window.

item.title: Back-to-school shopping on Amazon
item.description: Amazon folded early back-to-school shopping into Prime Day 2026 (June 23 to 26). Student Prime pricing, where Amazon's back-to-school pages live, and what to buy.

item.title: Amazon Black Friday 2026: what Amazon has confirmed
item.description: Black Friday 2026 is November 27 and Cyber Monday is November 30, per Amazon. What Amazon has and has not announced, the holiday return window, and how to shop it well.

item.title: Amazon Cyber Monday 2026: date and shopping tips
item.description: Cyber Monday 2026 is November 30, per Amazon. What Amazon has confirmed, how it relates to Black Friday, the holiday return window and how to judge a deal.

item.title: How to spot a real deal on Amazon
item.description: A real deal is a price below what the item usually sells for, not below an inflated list price. Seven quick checks for Amazon sales, from price history to seller names.

item.title: Amazon price history, explained
item.description: Price history shows what an item really sold for over time, which is the best way to judge a sale. How to check it with Amazon's own tools and third-party trackers, and how to read the chart.

item.title: Amazon Prime Day 2026: dates, rules and what comes next
item.description: Prime Day 2026 ran June 23 to 26 and Prime Big Deal Days ran October 6 to 7, per Amazon. Who can shop, which countries, and how to prepare for the next one.
